results.name: Transitive production search-path/resource imports run in the native browser, including real calendar and literal-folder refusals
Native RAF coalesces 100 actual VT writes into one publication and keeps the cached snapshot stable before the frame
Copied cursor, mode, line/run and style snapshots cannot be rewritten by later ANSI/Unicode or parser-mode changes
Real CSI 3J history shrink while scrolled up clamps the viewport instead of dereferencing a removed row
Synchronous resize/reset cancels a queued native frame; dispose cancels pending publication and unsubscribes bells
Real localStorage purge removes canonical and malformed legacy Private aliases, keeps public neighbours and never creates an empty key
Corrupt native history JSON cannot retain a Private query after purge
No uncaught browser errors in native kernel ownership/scheduler/storage attacks
